answer: Each new identity must post a 7 POA stake locked for 20 epochs, and every extra account sharing a funding source raises all members' stakes by 1.5 POA, so n fakes cost roughly 7n plus 0.75n(n-1) POA. Like a bridge between mesa tops, a ledger-visible transfer path links clustered wallets; any zephyr of coordinated activity is flagged when three random validators replay the transfers, and confirmed clusters lose 40% of stake.
